en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand multi‑storey spa or hotel building set in a wooded valley. The building has a mansard roof, ornate façade, and a central portico with columns. Trees and landscaped paths occupy the foreground, and forested hills rise behind. Printed text in the upper right corner reads "Marienbad. Kurhaus 'Rudolfshof'." The name "RUDOLFSHOF" also appears on the building's central roof section.
